exposure: Women who had a successful vaginal delivery
Women who had a failed trial of labor and required cesarean delivery
Mode of delivery (trial of vaginal delivery vs. planned cesarean delivery)
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies at >32 weeks gestation, with twin A in cephalic presentation and no contraindications for vaginal delivery
finding: Trial of vaginal delivery for twins at term when the first twin is in cephalic presentation was found to be as safe as elective cesarean delivery in terms of neonatal outcomes, although there was a higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage in the trial of vaginal delivery group.
mod_finding: Trial of vaginal delivery for twins at term when the first twin is in cephalic presentation was found to be safe and resulted in a high rate of vaginal delivery (91%).
